decisions.reason: The FAQ already states that referred mints award Small Block tickets and no-referral mints allocate tickets randomly; it does not claim that secondary sales generate new tickets.
A complete same-message MODIFY already requires commission totals to include randomly allocated no-referral commissions and exclude secondary-market sales.
The source changes ticket issuance reconciliation, not which sales fund or trigger the Small Block prize draw; secondary sales may remain qualifying draw sales without generating tickets.
A complete same-message MODIFY already requires visible totals to count one ticket per primary mint, including random no-referral allocations, while excluding secondary-market sales.
The ticket and commission count-reconciliation rule does not change the $15 primary-mint revenue allocations.
The source concerns randomly issued tickets failing to register in accounting totals and does not identify or change NFT metadata fields or counter visibility.
The About page already says referrals award tickets and no-code mints allocate a ticket randomly, without asserting that secondary sales generate new tickets.
The candidate already requires random no-referral ticket allocation, and its same-message RESUME records resolution of the prior uncertainty; no value change is required.
The Mission page describes the Small Block prize but does not define ticket generation for primary versus secondary sales.
Ticket and commission count reconciliation does not change automatic prize payout or the Winners-page announcement flow.
The source does not change Chainlink VRF, eligible winner selection, or ticket-based probability weighting.

The direct-referral commission remains an immediate $5 payment for a primary mint using a referral code; random no-referral commissions and displayed reconciliation are owned by separate Requirements.
